instruction.text: Build the name of the country.

hint.text: The official name of this country is the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
hint.label: Official name

instruction.text: What do you know about the DR Congo? Complete the fact file.
instruction.sound: What do you know about the D R Congo? Complete the fact file.

instruction.text: Which continent is the DR Congo in?
instruction.sound: Which continent is the D R Congo in?

trainers.finishSound: The D R Congo is in Africa.

instruction.text: What does the flag of the DR Congo look like?
instruction.sound: What does the flag of the D R Congo look like

instruction.text: Which currency belongs to the DR Congo?
instruction.sound: Which currency belongs to the D R Congo?

instruction.text: Read the text and select the matching image.

atoms.a: The Virunga National Park is the oldest national park in Africa and home to most of the world’s endangered mountain gorillas.
atoms.sound: The Virunga National park is the oldest national park in Africa and home to most of the world’s endangered mountain gorillas.

atoms.a: The okapi is found only in the rainforests of the DR Congo. It looks a bit like a horse with stripy legs, but it’s actually related to giraffes.
atoms.sound: The okapi is found only in the rain-forests of the D R Congo. It looks a bit like a horse with stripy legs, but it’s actually related to giraffes.

atoms.a: A popular dish in the DR Congo is fufu, which is made from pounded cassava root and is eaten with sauces.
atoms.sound: A popular dish in the D R Congo is fufu, which is made from pounded cassava root and is eaten with sauces.

atoms.a: The Congolese rumba is a cheerful type of music and dance.

atoms.b: The DR Congo is rich in valuable resources. The country supplies a large proportion of the world with cobalt, which is a ((++metal gas)) used in rechargeable batteries.
atoms.sound: The D R Congo is rich in valuable resources. The country supplies a large proportion of the world with cobalt, which is a metal used in rechargeable batteries.
